ex: Le médecin m'a conseillé une alimentation équilibrée.
exEn: The doctor advised me to eat a balanced diet.

word: avoir les yeux plus gros que le ventre
ipa: /a.vwaʁ le.z‿jø ply ɡʁo kə lə vɑ̃tʁ/
mean: to have eyes bigger than your stomach
ex: Au restaurant, mon fils a toujours les yeux plus gros que le ventre.
exEn: At restaurants, my son's eyes are always bigger than his stomach.

mean: to ring the changes, to mix things up

exEn: This summer, we'll mix things up: the sea, then the mountains.

word: mettre la main à la pâte
mean: to pitch in, to lend a hand
ex: Pour le déménagement, tous mes amis ont mis la main à la pâte.
exEn: For the move, all my friends pitched in.

ex: Le lait est un bon apport en calcium.
exEn: Milk is a good source of calcium.

mean: to get worked up, to overthink (informal)

exEn: Don't stress about it, it's only a small test.

mean: to still be hungry; to be left wanting more

exEn: The film ends too quickly, you're left wanting more.

exEn: Before a match, he eats lots of starchy food.

mean: to find what suits you, to get something out of it

exEn: At this market, young and old all find something they like.

exEn: A lentil soup is very filling.
